title: TAT-3903 Pro TWAP management tab proof
description: Proves the TWAP tab renders beside Positions and Orders in the Pro panel, carries the shared ticker-only and side filters, exposes the Active / History / Fill History views, and labels itself plain TWAP when no schedule is active.

proofTargets.claim: A third tab labelled TWAP renders beside Positions and Orders in the Pro panel and can be selected.
The TWAP tab exposes three selectable views — Active, History, and Fill History.
The TWAP tab carries the same side and ticker-only filters as the Positions and Orders tabs, and reads plain TWAP with no count while no schedule is active.

prepare-perps.intent: Prepare an unlocked HyperLiquid testnet BTC Pro market with no pre-existing BTC positions or orders.

wait-panel-tabs.intent: Confirm the Pro positions/orders panel tab bar is mounted before asserting the new tab.

wait-twap-tab.intent: Confirm the user is offered a TWAP tab next to Positions and Orders, which is the surface this ticket adds for monitoring running schedules.

open-twap-tab.intent: Select the TWAP tab so its own view switcher and filters render.

wait-view-active.intent: Assert the Active view is offered inside the TWAP tab.

wait-view-history.intent: Assert the History view is offered inside the TWAP tab.

wait-view-fill-history.intent: Assert the Fill History view is offered inside the TWAP tab.

wait-side-filter.intent: Assert the shared side filter stays available while the TWAP tab is selected.

wait-ticker-only.intent: Assert the shared ticker-only filter stays available while the TWAP tab is selected.

capture-twap-tab.label: TWAP tab selected beside Positions and Orders, showing the Active / History / Fill History switch, the shared All sides and BTC only filters, and the plain TWAP label with no count while no schedule is active.
capture-twap-tab.intent: Preserve the visible TWAP tab state for review.

restore-perps.intent: Return to Home and clear any BTC order or position left by the proof window.
